title: Admin creates a Junior plan price
description: Add a Junior price to an existing club plan from Payment Plans. Note: the same plan can exist for different member categories (segments) — one family key (for example Monthly) holds Regular, Junior, and other segment prices side by side. Junior must already be enabled under Segments before you can select it.

steps.title: Payment Plans
steps.body: Club plans are managed under Admin → Payment Plans. Seeded Monthly membership already has a Regular price.

steps.title: Add a segment price
steps.body: On Monthly membership, use + Segment to attach another category price to the same plan family — not a separate unrelated plan.

steps.title: Junior plan form
steps.body: The New Plan form reuses the Monthly name and family key. Segment is Junior (same offer, different category price).
steps.resultNote: Same plan family for different categories — Regular and Junior share one Monthly offer with separate prices.

steps.title: Set Junior price and create
steps.body: Enter the Junior total price (here $50.00), then Create Plan. Members in the Junior segment see this amount for Monthly.

steps.title: Junior price on Monthly
steps.body: Monthly membership now lists Regular and Junior. Players are charged the price for their member segment.
steps.resultNote: Junior plan created on the same Monthly family — one plan, multiple category prices.
